mapper.sql: ep.setting_id as "settingId", ep.evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", ep.teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", u.name as "teacherName", ep.area_code as "areaCode", ep.target_function_code as "targetFunctionCode", ep.exception_start_at as "exceptionStartAt", ep.exception_end_at as "exceptionEndAt", ep.approval_reason as "approvalReason", ep.active_yn as "activeYn", ep.created_by as "createdBy", ep.updated_by as "updatedBy", ep.created_at as "createdAt", ep.updated_at as "updatedAt", ep.change_reason as "changeReason"
from exception_period_settings ep left join users u on u.user_id = ep.teacher_user_id

where.if: and (ep.evaluation_year ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ep.area_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ep.target_function_code ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or ep.approval_reason ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%') or u.name ilike concat('%', #{criteria.normalizedKeyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: insert into exception_period_settings (evaluation_year, teacher_user_id, area_code, target_function_code, exception_start_at, exception_end_at, approval_reason, active_yn, change_reason, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.evaluationYear}, #{request.teacherUserId}, #{request.areaCode}, #{request.targetFunctionCode}, #{request.exceptionStartAt}, #{request.exceptionEndAt}, #{request.approvalReason}, #{request.activeYn}, #{request.changeReason}, #{userId}, #{userId}) returning setting_id as "settingId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", (select name from users where user_id = exception_period_settings.teacher_user_id) as "teacherName", area_code as "areaCode", target_function_code as "targetFunctionCode", exception_start_at as "exceptionStartAt", exception_end_at as "exceptionEndAt", approval_reason as "approvalReason", active_yn as "activeYn", created_by as "createdBy", updated_by as "updatedBy", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"

update exception_period_settings set evaluation_year = #{request.evaluationYear}, teacher_user_id = #{request.teacherUserId}, area_code = #{request.areaCode}, target_function_code = #{request.targetFunctionCode}, exception_start_at = #{request.exceptionStartAt}, exception_end_at = #{request.exceptionEndAt}, approval_reason = #{request.approvalReason}, active_yn = #{request.activeYn}, change_reason = #{request.changeReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{userId} where setting_id = #{request.settingId} returning setting_id as "settingId", evaluation_year as "evaluationYear", teacher_user_id as "teacherUserId", (select name from users where user_id = exception_period_settings.teacher_user_id) as "teacherName", area_code as "areaCode", target_function_code as "targetFunctionCode", exception_start_at as "exceptionStartAt", exception_end_at as "exceptionEndAt", approval_reason as "approvalReason", active_yn as "activeYn", created_by as "createdBy", updated_by as "updatedBy", created_at as "createdAt", updated_at as "updatedAt", change_reason as "changeReason"
select count(*) from users u where u.user_id = #{teacherUserId} and u.status = 'ACTIVE' and u.system_use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: insert into data_change_histories (target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id) values (#{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId})
